description: This file defines an Android activity named PrintCustomContent that demonstrates custom printing functionality for a list of MotoGP championship statistics. It includes inline implementation of a PrintDocumentAdapter with detailed layout and write operations, and uses internal classes for data items and adapters.

classes.name: MotoGpStatItem
classes.description: A simple data class holding MotoGP statistics: year, champion, and constructor.

classes.name: MotoGpStatAdapter
classes.description: A custom adapter extending BaseAdapter to bind MotoGpStatItem data to list item views, with ability to clone its items.

methods.name: onCreate
methods.description: Initializes activity and sets the list adapter with MotoGP data.

methods.name: onCreateOptionsMenu
methods.description: Inflates the options menu for printing.

methods.name: onOptionsItemSelected
methods.description: Handles menu item selection to trigger printing.

methods.name: print
methods.description: Sets up and starts the print job, implementing inline a custom PrintDocumentAdapter with layout and write logic.

methods.name: loadMotoGpStats
methods.description: Loads MotoGP data from resources and returns a list of MotoGpStatItem objects.

methods.name: measureView
methods.description: Utility method to measure a view's dimensions given current layout parameters.

methods.name: computeWrittenPageRanges
methods.description: Computes an array of PageRange objects based on pages that were written to the PDF.

methods.name: containsPage
methods.description: Checks if a page index is within a list of PageRanges.
